newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya police shoot live rounds at students.
newsitem.headline: Kenya police shoot live rounds at students.

text.p: Police opened fire with assault rifles over the heads and in the direction of stone-throwing students in the Kenyan capital Nairobi on Monday, witnesses said.
"Police and GSU (General Service Unit) fired over their heads and at the students but they apparently missed because I didn't see anyone fall," said a Reuters correspondent at the scene.

He said some 50 police and GSU paramilitary police were confronting about 150 students who were throwing stones across the main highway in Nairobi. He said teargas fired earlier failed to disperse the students, who were near their residences.
